We are looking for a CNC / Robotics Maintenance Engineer to join our team.
The Maintenance Engineer is responsible for ensuring the efficient and reliable operation of machinery and equipment within the facility. The team's scope includes the CNC and CMM fleets along with their respective robotics hardware (including vertical loading machines), pre and post-processing equipment (tool setters, bandsaw), general facilities and office systems, and the entire stack of electronic controllers that link hardware to [Company name masked]'s software systems.

Handle the electrical wiring setups and modifications necessary for machinery and equipment. Coordinate with vendors for specialized repair services and over-time build an in-house playbook to enable [Company name masked] to maintain all equipment internally. Conduct upgrades and installations related to pneumatics systems to optimize performance. Install and maintain edge devices and RFID technology to support operational and tracking capabilities. Develop and execute maintenance schedules and procedures to ensure compliance with safety standards and operational efficiency. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve equipment issues and to support continuous improvement initiatives.

Familiarity with robotic cell operations and vertical loading machinery.

Background in controls engineering.

The team's scope includes the CNC and CMM fleets along with their respective robotics hardware (including vertical loading machines), pre and post-processing equipment (tool setters, bandsaw), general facilities and office systems, and the entire stack of electronic controllers that link hardware to [Company name masked]'s software systems.
cond_0090.responsibilities:
Work with the team to perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting of robotic cells and vertical loading machines to minimize downtime and maintain operational efficiency.
Handle the electrical wiring setups and modifications necessary for machinery and equipment.
Coordinate with vendors for specialized repair services and over time help build an in-house playbook so [Company name masked] can maintain all equipment internally.
Work alongside colleagues to conduct upgrades and installations related to pneumatics systems to optimize performance.
Install and maintain edge devices and RFID technology to support operational and tracking capabilities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and execute maintenance schedules and procedures, ensuring compliance with safety standards and operational efficiency.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by helping identify and resolve equipment issues together with cross-functional partners.
cond_0090.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Instead of a BA, 5 years of direct experience may be substituted.
Proven experience in mechanical and electrical maintenance in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
Strong understanding of mechanical systems, electrical wiring, and pneumatics.
Familiarity with robotic cell operations and vertical loading machinery.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to perform under pressure.
Experience with RFID and edge device technologies.
Controls engineering skillset.
Software engineering experience or interest.

cond_0279.intro:
[Company name masked] builds software-defined high-precision component factories for the top aerospace companies in the world. We are looking for people who want to work alongside our engineers and machinists to push manufacturing forward.
The Maintenance Engineer works with the team to ensure the reliable operation of machinery and equipment within the facility. The team's shared scope includes the CNC and CMM fleets along with their respective robotics hardware (including vertical loading machines), pre and post-processing equipment (tool setters, bandsaw), general facilities and office systems, and the entire stack of electronic controllers that link hardware to [Company name masked]'s software systems.
cond_0279.responsibilities:
Work with the team to perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting of robotic cells and vertical loading machines, helping minimize downtime and keep operations running smoothly.
Handle electrical wiring setups and modifications needed for machinery and equipment.
Coordinate with vendors for specialized repair services and, over time, help build an in-house playbook so [Company name masked] can maintain all equipment internally.
Work alongside colleagues to conduct upgrades and installations related to pneumatics systems.
Install and maintain edge devices and RFID technology to support operational and tracking needs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and execute maintenance schedules and procedures that meet safety standards and operational requirements.
Help identify and resolve equipment issues and support continuous improvement efforts across the team.
cond_0279.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field — or 5 years of direct experience in lieu of a degree.
Proven experience in mechanical and electrical maintenance in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
Strong understanding of mechanical systems, electrical wiring, and pneumatics.
Familiarity with robotic cell operations and vertical loading machinery.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with RFID and edge device technologies.
Controls engineering skillset.
Software engineering experience or interest.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to perform under pressure.
ITAR REQUIREMENTS:
To conform to [Location masked] Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a [Location masked] citizen, lawful permanent resident of [Location masked], protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324B(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the [Location masked] Department of State. cond_0291.intro:
We are looking for a CNC / Robotics Maintenance Engineer to join our team.
The Maintenance Engineer is responsible for ensuring the efficient and reliable operation of machinery and equipment within the facility. The team's scope includes the CNC and CMM fleets along with their respective robotics hardware (including vertical loading machines), pre and post-processing equipment (tool setters, bandsaw), general facilities and office systems, and the entire stack of electronic controllers that link hardware to [Company name masked]'s software systems.

Handle the electrical wiring setups and modifications necessary for machinery and equipment. Coordinate with vendors for specialized repair services and over-time build an in-house playbook to enable [Company name masked] to maintain all equipment internally. Conduct upgrades and installations related to pneumatics systems to optimize performance. Install and maintain edge devices and RFID technology to support operational and tracking capabilities. Working knowledge of mechanical systems, electrical wiring, and pneumatics.
Familiarity with robotic cell operations and vertical loading machinery.

Experience with RFID and edge device technologies.
Background in controls engineering.
Some exposure to software engineering, or an interest in developing that skill over time.
Ability to communicate effectively under pressure and openness to working through problems with a team.
